facts.value: University of Limerick is located on the west coast of Ireland along the River Shannon.
The campus enjoys an unspoiled natural environment blended with state-of-the-art teaching and research facilities.
University of Limerick has been voted number one in the world for student experience.
More than 100 taught postgraduate programmes to Doctoral and Post-doctoral level.
UL Global assists all international students coming to UL under Postgraduate, Undergraduate, Study Abroad, Erasmus+, Exchange and Summer School programmes.
